html: Your enquiry about the redesign of your customer portal

Thank you for your enquiry of 28 October and for taking the time to show us your current portal last week. We were impressed by how much your customers already do online, and we can see clear ways to make it simpler and faster for them.

Please find enclosed our proposal for the redesign. We suggest working in three phases – discovery, design and development – so that you can review the results after each phase and decide how to continue. We could start the discovery phase as early as 1 December 2026.
Our proposal is valid until 15 December 2026. If you have any questions, or would like to talk through the details in person, please call me on +44 20 7946 0158 or write to jane.doe@example.com.
We look forward to working with you.
